_comment: Single source of truth for the pinned CI tool versions that have no other canonical home in this repo. GCC/LLVM majors are NOT duplicated here - they live in .github/toolchain/02-gcc-toolchain.sh and 03-llvm-toolchain.sh (copied verbatim from aqualink-automate so both projects pin the same toolchain; changing that pin means editing the script, same as today). CMake's minimum lives in CMakePresets.json's cmakeMinimumRequired. vcpkg's baseline lives in vcpkg.json's builtin-baseline. llvm_windows_version is the one partial exception: it's the exact LLVM point release (major.minor.patch) _build.yml's Windows step downloads as a win64 installer, since Windows has no versioned package to pin against the way apt does - it must match whatever micro version 03-llvm-toolchain.sh's LLVM_VERSION resolves to on Ubuntu 26.04 (check with `apt-cache policy clang-<major>` before bumping). _toolchain-versions.yml asserts its major matches llvm_version so the two can't silently drift apart. .github/workflows/_toolchain-versions.yml reads all of the above plus this file and exposes one uniform set of outputs, so bumping a version is a one-file change (this one, the relevant toolchain script, CMakePresets.json, or vcpkg.json) instead of hunting down every workflow that hardcoded a copy. aqtsource is the aqtinstall that install-qt-action installs INSTEAD of PyPI's (its `aqtsource` input), as a git commit. It exists because Qt split the Windows x64 online repository per architecture from 6.11 (qt6_6120/qt6_6120_msvc2022_64/ instead of qt6_6120/qt6_6120/), which aqtinstall 3.3.0 - the last PyPI release, June 2025 - cannot read: every 6.11.x and 6.12.0 install failed on Windows alone, with 'Failed to locate XML data' on a doubled qt6_NNNN/qt6_NNNN/Updates.xml path. aqtinstall PR #1000 fixed that on master in March 2026 and no release has carried it since, so this pins the master commit that was installed and verified (aqt list-qt --modules and a full install of 6.12.0 win64_msvc2022_64, 2026-10-13). Drop the key, which makes the action fall back to PyPI, once an aqtinstall release newer than 3.3.0 includes that fix. The commit needs py7zr >= 1.1.3, which the action's own py7zr==1.1.0 pin is upgraded to by pip, since the action installs py7zr and aqtinstall in two separate pip calls. Bumping qt: run `aqt list-qt <host> desktop --modules <version> <arch>` per host AND a real install first - a bare version listing passed for 6.11.2 while the install failed (#989). See docs/ci-self-hosted-runners.md.
